qrAssets.title: Generate QR Codes for Your Assets
qrAssets.description: Upload each unique asset once, choose how many QR codes you need, then pick exactly where the QR should sit on the design.
qrAssets.step1Description: Upload one copy of each unique asset and tell us how many QR codes you want for each.
qrAssets.step2Title: Choose where QR codes should appear
qrAssets.step2Description: For each asset, set the area where QR codes should be placed when we generate your files.
qrAssets.step3Description: We’ll create one PDF per asset, with one page per unique QR code using your chosen placement.

info.uniqueAssets: Upload only one of each unique asset – don’t upload duplicates.
info.activationAndMap: It doesn’t matter which QR code goes where. As soon as any code is scanned, it will activate and show up on the map.
info.generateMoreLater: If you lose a poster or need more, you can always generate more QR codes later.

qrAssets.uploadAssetsDescription: Each file should be a different asset.
qrAssets.uniqueAssetsHelper: Please upload a single copy of each unique asset only. Avoid uploading the same design more than once.
qrAssets.quantitiesHelper: Use the quantity field on the right to set how many QR codes you want for each asset.
qrAssets.noAssetsYet: No assets yet. Upload at least one image to get started.
qrAssets.drawPlacementHelper: Draw or fine-tune the square where your QR code should appear on this asset. We’ll place each QR in this exact region.
qrAssets.numericPlacementDescription: Use percentages so your QR placement scales correctly for high-resolution, print-ready files.
qrAssets.noSelectedAsset: Select an asset above to choose where its QR codes should go.
qrAssets.reviewSummary: Review your assets and how many QR-coded pages we’ll generate for each before downloading.
qrAssets.pdfGenerationComingSoon: We’ll generate one PDF per asset with one page per QR code. This is coming soon in your current build.

errors.noAssetsOrQuantities: Upload at least one asset and set a quantity greater than 0 before continuing.
